::: {.callout-note icon="false"}
## Definition: Statistical Query
Given a distribution $P$ over a set $X$, there is said to be a statistical query model of precision $\tau$ if for any function $\phi: X \to [-1,1]$, there exists an algorithm that outputs a variable $v$ such that $|v -\mathbb{E}_{x \sim P}\phi(x)|\leq \tau$
:::
